title: Cohomology Vanishing, Koszul Cohomology and Multigraded Regularity on Projective Varieties
summary: In this article, we prove a general cohomology vanishing theorem on arbitrary projective varieties within the framework of multigraded Castelnuovo--Mumford regularity. In particular, we apply this vaishing theorem to prove the vanishing of Koszul cohomology groups $K_{p,q}(X;F,L)$, where $L=B_1^{w_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes B_t^{w_t}$, the line bundles $B_1,\ldots,B_t$ are globally generated, and $F$ is a vector bundle.
